original_idea: 我想研究利用机器学习或深度学习模型，基于公开 ICU 临床数据预测患者发生急性肾损伤的风险。请分析目前是否已经有类似研究、已有研究主要采用哪些方法、可能存在什么研究差异，以及这个想法在数据、方法、算力和验证方面是否具有可行性。

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Early Warning System for Acute Kidney Injury Driven by Multi-Center ICU Database

evidence.text: In this paper, we have integrated most of the routinely available ICU data based on two large ICU databases with general population to developed and externally validated an ideal artificial intelligence assisted early warning system for predicting the onset of AKI within the first week of ICU stay.

As a result, we have got an ideal incidence of AKI in both eICU and MIMIC-III cohort, which would minimize the potential mistakes and maximize the accuracy and improving of predicting model performance in clinical situation.
Third, we compared 8 modern machine learning algorithms for further analysis to select the best model of predicting task.
